Justification: Important for admins and decisions but the library can run without it initially; simple queries.

Justification: Speeds up the desk, but barcode/manual ID entry works; needs scanner hardware/camera support.

Requirement: Allow users to review and rate books
Justification: Nice engagement feature; no effect on core circulation.

Justification: Costly (NLP, training, hosting) with low immediate value; revisit later.
